title: domain.simulator-guide output
description: Shape the simulator-guide writes when a pedagogical copy patch is ready for review.

level_id.description: Identifier of the Level the patch targets. Example: Level01 or glossary.

files_touched.description: Paths of the files touched, relative to the repo root.

summary.description: One- or two-sentence summary of the pedagogical change.

decision_ref.description: Optional reference to a DEC-STUDY-* record when the change crosses a pedagogical threshold.
